title: Supreme Court of India
author: built-in
review: not reviewed: each quote was read in the Supreme Court Rules, 2013 (Gazette text) on 2026-11-16; the advocate checks each list

items.text: The petition is in Form No. 28; any interim prayer is in the petition, with no separate application.
items.quote: shall be in Form No. 28 appended to the rules

items.text: A list of dates in chronological order, with the material facts of each date, goes with the petition.
items.quote: list of dates in chronological order with relevant material facts or events pertaining to each of the dates shall be furnished

items.text: Annexures are documents of the record below, numbered Annexure 1, 2, 3, in chronological order, and each is indexed separately; the petition gives their page numbers.
items.quote: The documents shall not be indexed collectively and each document shall be indexed separately

items.text: A document that was not part of the record below needs a separate application with the reasons.
items.quote: he shall make a separate application stating the reasons for not producing it

items.text: The English text of the provisions referred to in the impugned judgment is filed as an Appendix.
items.quote: referred to in the impugned judgment or order shall be filed as Appendix to the Special Leave Petition

items.text: An affidavit of the petitioner (or an authorised person) supports the petition and the list of dates.
items.quote: Every petition shall be supported by the affidavit of the petitioners or one of the petitioners

items.text: The papers are in this order: list of dates, certified copy of the judgment, the petition (Form No. 28), the Appendix, the annexures.
items.quote: shall be arranged in the following order: (i) List of dates

items.text: The petition says whether an earlier SLP was filed against the same judgment, and with what result, on affidavit.
items.quote: statement as to whether the petitioner had filed any petition for special leave to appeal against the impugned judgment or order earlier

items.text: The petition says whether the matter was contested below, with the names and addresses of the contesting parties.
items.quote: whether the matter was contested in the Court appealed from

items.text: The petition says whether a letters patent appeal or a writ appeal lies, and whether it was availed.
items.quote: whether a letters patent appeal or writ appeal lies against the impugned judgment or order

items.text: A certified copy of the judgment or order appealed from is filed.
items.quote: a certified copy of the judgment or order appealed from

items.text: An affidavit supports the statement of facts in the petition.
items.quote: an affidavit in support of the statement of facts contained in the petition

items.text: Annexures are certified copies, or uncertified copies affirmed as true copies on affidavit.
items.quote: uncertified copies of documents may be accepted as annexures if such copies are affirmed to be true copies upon affidavit

items.text: At least three spare sets of the petition and its papers are filed.
items.quote: The petitioner shall file at least three spare sets of the petition and of the accompanying papers

items.text: A petition filed after the period of limitation carries an application for condonation of delay.
items.quote: accompanied by an application for condonation of delay

lists.title: Limitation for a special leave petition (civil)

items.text: Ninety days from the date of the judgment or order appealed from, subject to sections 4, 5, 12 and 14 of the Limitation Act, 1963.
items.quote: in any other case within ninety days from the date of the judgment or order sought to be appealed from

items.text: Sixty days from the order of refusal, where the High Court refused a certificate of fitness to appeal.
items.quote: be lodged in the Court within sixty days from the date of the order of refusal

items.text: Excluded: the time from an application for leave to appeal from a single Judge to its rejection.
items.quote: the period from the making of that application and the rejection thereof shall also be excluded

lists.title: Order XXI: special leave petitions (civil), rule by rule
From instruction to filing: special leave petition (civil)

items.text: Analyse the impugned judgment.
Check the chronology for contradictions and confirm the dates.
Generate the list of dates from the confirmed events.
Propose the issues and decide them at the case conference.
Work out the limitation from the date of the impugned judgment; confirm it.
Review the drafts, their citations and their grounding.
Tick the filing checklist and run the format checks.
Approve for filing; the filing set and its signed manifest are made.

requiredParts: Certified copy of the impugned judgment
intakeQuestions: What is the date of the impugned judgment?
Was a certificate of fitness refused by the High Court?
Was an earlier SLP filed against the same judgment?
Does a letters patent or writ appeal lie, and was it availed?
